masters.name: The Masters (Augusta National)
masters.notes: Official full-colour horizontal logo (US-map/flag emblem + 'Masters' script) used in masters.com nav, found via the site stylesheet. BELOW the 400px target: no larger official file or brand kit is published. Interlaced RGBA PNG with alpha channel (pixel-level alpha not verified). Alternatives seen: emblem-only SVG https://www.masters.com/assets/images/longarticle/top_logo.svg (75x72, all-white fill) not used; Wikipedia File:Masters_Logo.png is only 295x283.

pga-championship.name: PGA Championship
pga-championship.notes: Official navy Wanamaker-trophy 'PGA CHAMPIONSHIP' stacked logo (schema.org #logo of pgachampionship.com); original behind the site's Brightspot image proxy. Alpha verified (~85% fully transparent px).

us-open.name: U.S. Open (USGA)
us-open.notes: Official full-colour U.S. Open trophy + 'US OPEN' logo from the usopen.com header (USGA Cloudinary original, no transforms). usopen.com/usga.org block curl (Akamai 403), so the page was inspected in a real browser; robots.txt could not be read for the same reason. Alpha verified.

the-open.name: The Open (R&A)
the-open.notes: 'THE OPEN' logo with the Claret Jug inside the O. Non-free English-Wikipedia upload (not Commons); file page cites source https://www.teamcard.com/2016/12/08/teamcard-wins-the-open-september-2016/ . Official route failed: theopen.com header only serves logo-the-open-symbol.png at 102x105, white-only; no brand/press kit found on theopen.com or randa.org. Alpha verified.

players.name: THE PLAYERS Championship
players.notes: Official PGA TOUR-hosted THE PLAYERS logo SVG (Illustrator export), referenced as homeNavIconOverride in the PGA TOUR web platform config embedded in rydercup.com. REVERSE colourway: 'THE PLAYERS' lettering is WHITE (#fff) with gold (#ca7) golfer, intended for dark backgrounds. theplayers.com header only exposes a 200x52 PNG of the same reverse mark. Wikipedia infobox for the event has no logo.

fedex-cup.name: FedExCup
fedex-cup.notes: Official pgatour.com file; per founder decision 2026-11-06 the opaque white square background was removed (edge-connected near-white pixels made transparent, enclosed whites kept) and the empty margin trimmed to 460x101. Colours otherwise unchanged. Original: fedex-cup.png.

ryder-cup.name: Ryder Cup
ryder-cup.source_site: en.wikipedia.org (non-free file of the official mark)
ryder-cup.notes: Year-less shield ("EST. 1927") per founder decision 2026-11-06, replacing the official rydercup.com 2027 match shield (https://res.cloudinary.com/rydercup-prod/image/upload/v1759097434/rydercup/Ryder%20Cup%20Shields/RC_MatchShield_2027_RGB.svg). Unmodified.

presidents-cup.name: Presidents Cup
presidents-cup.notes: Official primary logo (gold cup in arc + grey 'PRESIDENTS CUP') from the site header. NOT a true vector: the SVG wraps one embedded 1919x1422 WebP raster (VP8X, alpha flag set). Server sends it with Content-Encoding: gzip; saved as the decoded SVG (what a browser receives), bytes otherwise unmodified. Commons alternative File:PresidentsCup--Primary.png (960x708, 'Own work') not used.

liv.name: LIV Golf
liv.notes: Official 'liv-golf-primary.svg' used as a CSS mask for the livgolf.com header logo. Single-colour WHITE fill (site colours it via CSS), so it will be invisible on a white background as-is. width/height attrs are 100%; dimensions are the viewBox (128x25, vector).

ncaa.name: NCAA
ncaa.notes: Official NCAA primary disc logo (blue #009cde circle, white NCAA, registered mark) from the ncaa.org header. Dimensions from viewBox.

us-amateur.name: U.S. Amateur (USGA logo)
us-amateur.notes: USGA logo, NOT a U.S. Amateur mark: the championship has no distinct year-agnostic logo; championships.usga.org/usamateur.html only shows a year/venue-specific '127th U.S. Amateur Oak Hill CC' mark (27-usam-300.png, 300x300). This is the 2025 USGA logo from the usga.org header (Cloudinary original, served as PNG). Alpha verified.

oklahoma-state.name: Oklahoma State Cowboys (OSU brand)
oklahoma-state.notes: Fallback: no direct official download (brand.okstate.edu returns 403; okstate.com header only has a wordmark SVG and a 200px site.png). En.wiki File:Oklahoma_State_Athletics_logo.svg redirects to Commons File:Oklahoma_State_University_system_logo.svg, which is the orange/black 'OSU' brand mark used as the athletics primary; tagged PD-textlogo. Original source cited on file page: Official website (http://okstate.com). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oklahoma_State_Cowboys_and_Cowgirls

arizona-state.name: Arizona State Sun Devils (pitchfork)
arizona-state.notes: Fallback: official pitchfork SVG referenced on thesundevils.com returned 404; ASU brand files not publicly linked. Non-free fair-use logo hosted on en.wikipedia. Original source cited on file page: none listed. Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Arizona_State_Sun_Devils

texas.name: Texas Longhorns (Longhorn silhouette)
texas.notes: Official site header logo; single-color burnt orange (#C15D26) Longhorn silhouette, which is the primary mark. brand.utexas.edu downloads are via Box folder only.

georgia.name: Georgia Bulldogs (oval G)
georgia.notes: Fallback: georgiadogs.com header SVG is a one-color black G variant, not the full-color primary; UGA licensing files not publicly linked. Commons file is the full-color black G / white oval / red border primary. Tagged public domain on Commons. Original source cited on file page: http://www.sportslogos.net/logo.php?id=hr85j3g1duiqf59eiep9bvnsd (http://www.sportslogos.net/logo.php?id=hr85j3g1duiqf59eiep9bvnsd). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Georgia_Bulldogs

wake-forest.name: Wake Forest Demon Deacons (WF)
wake-forest.notes: Fallback: godeacs.com nav SVG is a one-color gold WF without the black outline; Commons file is the full-color gold WF with black outline primary. Original source cited on file page: http://www.wfbrandstandards.com/logos.html#logo, colors from http://www.wfu.edu/identity/guide/wfu_identity.colors_and_paper_stock.pdf (http://www.wfbrandstandards.com/logos.html#logo, http://www.wfu.edu/identity/guide/wfu_identity.colors_and_paper_stock.pdf). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wake_Forest_Demon_Deacons

unlv.name: UNLV Rebels (arched UNLV)
unlv.notes: Fallback: unlvrebels.com header SVG is a white/outline variant for dark backgrounds. Commons file is named 'wordmark' but is the red arched 'UNLV' letters with black outline, which is UNLV's primary athletics mark (no separate pictorial primary exists). Original source cited on file page: UNLV Identity website (http://www.unlv.edu/identity/downloads). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UNLV_Rebels

florida.name: Florida Gators (gator head)
florida.notes: Official site header logo; full-color gator head primary (green #046A38, blue #003087, orange #FA4616).

houston.name: Houston Cougars (interlocking UH)
houston.notes: Fallback: uhcougars.com header SVG is a one-color red outline variant; Commons file is the full-color primary UH (labelled primary logo). Original source cited on file page: http://www.uhcougars.com/licensing/logos.html (http://www.uhcougars.com/licensing/logos.html). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Houston_Cougars

georgia-tech.name: Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets (GT, 2026)
georgia-tech.notes: Image asset in ramblinwreck.com page data titled 'GT_onLightBackgrounds.png', caption 'Georgia Tech primary logo (2026)'; original storage URL behind the site's imgproxy. RGBA with transparent background (~51% of pixels alpha<255). Official SVG files are by request only (ideation@athletics.gatech.edu).

stanford.name: Stanford Cardinal (block S with tree)
stanford.notes: Fallback: gostanford.com only exposes a 155x44 header PNG; no official SVG found. Commons file is the block S with tree primary; width/height in pt. Original source cited on file page: 12-03-2016 Game Notes MBB (http://sidearm.sites.s3.amazonaws.com/gostanford.com/documents/2016/12/2/Stanford_Men_s_Basketball_Game_Notes_at_Kansas.pdf). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stanford_Cardinal

illinois.name: Illinois Fighting Illini (Block I)
illinois.notes: Fallback: fightingillini.com nav SVG is a plain orange Block I without the blue outline; brand.illinois.edu downloads are Box folders. Commons file is the orange Block I with blue outline primary. Original source cited on file page: Illinois Athletics Unveils Updated Brand Identity press release (http://www.fightingillini.com/news/2014/4/16/Illinois_Athletics_Unveils_Updated_Brand_Identity.aspx). Article: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illinois_Fighting_Illini

florida-state.name: Florida State Seminoles (Seminole head)
florida-state.notes: Official site header logo; full-color Seminole head primary. Same site also serves an identical-design logo_main.svg at 100x100.

usc.name: USC Trojans
usc.notes: Interlocking SC primary mark. Commons cites source: http://www.usctrojans.com/. Official file not reachable as a direct download (only 200px Sidearm site.png on usctrojans.com).

ucla.name: UCLA Bruins
ucla.notes: Script 'UCLA' primary athletics logo. Commons cites UCLA Nike/Jordan style guide PDF: https://s3.amazonaws.com/sidearm.sites/uclabruins.com/documents/2021/7/7/UCLA_Nike_Jordan_Style_Guide_20212.pdf. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

clemson.name: Clemson Tigers
clemson.notes: Tiger Paw primary mark. Commons cites https://www.clemson.edu/brand/guide/logo.html. Checked clemson.edu/brand/logo and clemsontigers.com/styleguide: no direct public logo file links (downloads gated/JS).

alabama.name: Alabama Crimson Tide
alabama.notes: Script A primary mark. Commons cites rolltide.com logo sheet PDF: https://rolltide.com/documents/2018/6/28//Alabama201819LogosCopy.pdf. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

lsu.name: LSU Tigers
lsu.notes: LSU letters primary athletics mark. Commons file page says source http://lsu.edu/ and 'Recreated, by hand, in SVG format by User:Andrew c' -- a hand recreation, not the original vector. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

oklahoma.name: Oklahoma Sooners
oklahoma.notes: Interlocking OU primary mark. Commons cites soonersports.com PDF: https://s3.amazonaws.com/soonersports.com/documents/2018/5/8/5473175.pdf. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

north-carolina.name: North Carolina Tar Heels
north-carolina.notes: Interlocking NC primary mark (Carolina blue fill, navy border). SVG has viewBox only (170x134), no width/height attrs; en.wikipedia reports nominal 512x404. Commons cites Carolina Athletics Branding Guidelines (goheels.com) and archived UNC licensing logo sheet. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

auburn.name: Auburn Tigers
auburn.notes: Interlocking AU primary mark. Commons cites http://www.auburn.edu/administration/trademark/logos.pdf and earlier en.wikipedia File:AuburnTigers.png. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

texas-a-and-m.name: Texas A&M Aggies
texas-a-and-m.notes: ATM-in-Texas primary logo (2021-present). PNG, RGBA (sips hasAlpha: yes). Commons cites sportslogos.net (Chris Creamer): https://www.sportslogos.net/logos/view/86656342021/Texas_AM_Aggies/2021/Primary_Logo. brand.tamu.edu did not resolve; no official file found.

smu.name: SMU Mustangs
smu.notes: Running mustang (Peruna) mark used as Wikipedia athletics infobox logo. Commons cites SMU Brand Guidelines p.11 (archived): https://web.archive.org/web/20110516081230/http://smu.edu/brand/pdf/SMU%20BrandGuidelines.pdf. Note: SMU athletics also uses an 'SMU' lettermark; confirm which is primary. Official file not reachable as a direct download.

arizona.name: Arizona Wildcats
arizona.notes: Block A primary mark. Commons cites UA ID guide PDF: http://externalrelations.arizona.edu/styleguide/pdf/UA_ID_Guide.pdf. marcom.arizona.edu says logo files are by request (brand@arizona.edu); no public download.

vanderbilt.name: Vanderbilt Commodores
vanderbilt.notes: V mark (black fill, gold outline). CAUTION: this SVG is a wrapper around an embedded 596x418 PNG (one <image> data URI), not true vector. Commons cites 'Vanderbilt University Athletics' (no URL). Official alternatives seen but not used: vucommodores.com site SVG https://vucommodores.com/_nuxt/logo.DUna9UIH.svg (true vector, 57x40, but the gold-fill/white-outline on-dark variant) and brand.vanderbilt.edu/athletics usage sheet V_logo.png (6 colorways on gray tiles, not a usable single mark); full official files are in a Box folder linked from vucommodores.com/vanderbilt-athletics-brand-guide (not downloaded).

ohio-state.name: Ohio State Buckeyes
ohio-state.notes: Athletic 'O / OHIO STATE' primary mark used as the site header logo. Only <rect> is inside a clipPath, no background. No public brand-download page found.

california.name: California Golden Bears
california.notes: Script 'Cal' primary mark (navy). Commons cites 'Cal website' (http://www.calbears.com/). Official calbears.com logo_main.svg returned 404; brand.berkeley.edu has no public athletics download (directs to Intercollegiate Athletics).

washington.name: Washington Huskies
washington.notes: Block W primary athletics mark (purple with gold outline), site header logo.

san-diego-state.name: San Diego State Aztecs
san-diego-state.notes: SD-spear primary mark. Commons cites 'SDSU User Manual' (http://advancement.sdsu.edu/marcomm/brand/usermanual052312.pdf). brand.sdsu.edu/identity/logos/athletics has no downloadable files (institutional EPS/PNG only); goaztecs.com itself serves this same Wikipedia render (2560px-San_Diego_State_Aztecs_logo.svg.png).

ole-miss.name: Ole Miss Rebels
ole-miss.notes: Red script 'Ole Miss' primary athletics logo (nav logo). Preferred over Commons Ole-miss_logo_from_NCAA.svg (sourced from ncaa.com).

arkansas.name: Arkansas Razorbacks
arkansas.notes: Full-color running Razorback. Hosted on en.wikipedia under non-free logo rationale; file page cites no original source. Official arkansasrazorbacks.com only exposes white (ark-logo-left.png 550x233) and black/white (arkansas-dark-logo.png 242x106) variants, not the full-color primary.

tcu.name: TCU Horned Frogs
tcu.notes: Arched purple 'TCU' primary mark. Commons cites 'Official website' (http://www.gofrogs.com). Official gofrogs.com main_nav_logo.svg (same mark, 120x58) exists but is white-only (reverse) so the full-color Commons file was used.

kent-state.name: Kent State Golden Flashes
kent-state.notes: Primary 'K' with golden flash athletics mark (site header). Vector, so small nominal size is not a limit.

augusta.name: Augusta University Jaguars
augusta.notes: 'Victory A' primary athletics mark (file named logo-primary.svg; width/height attrs only, no viewBox). Also on brand.augusta.edu/spirit-marks as a 1024x552 PNG (https://ocmsites.org/styleguide/wp-content/uploads/sites/18/2016/01/AugustaUniversity_VictoryA_rgb_registered-1024x552.png), not saved.

byu.name: BYU Cougars
byu.notes: Stretch-Y oval primary mark. Commons cites BYU Identity Guidelines (http://identity.byu.edu), tagged PD-textlogo. CAUTION: fill is #003DA5 (royal blue), the older palette; current BYU navy is #002E5D. brand.byu.edu/unit-logos/athletics only offers block-byu, cougar-head and athletics-wordmark zips; its stretch-y.svg is a usage illustration with a patterned background, not a clean logo. Preferred over the en.wiki BYU_Stretch_Y_Logo.png (cited sportslogos.net).

duke.name: Duke Blue Devils
duke.notes: Iron Duke 'D' primary athletics mark with registered symbol (site header). trademarklicensing.duke.edu offers no public SVG.

virginia.name: Virginia Cavaliers
virginia.notes: V-Sabre (confirmed as the primary athletics logo by brand.virginia.edu/design-assets/athletics). en.wikipedia non-free file, no original source cited. The official brand page shows it only as an 800x800 JPG (https://brand.virginia.edu/sites/uva_brand/files/2023-07/36_Ath_800x800.jpg) with no transparency, so it was not used.

texas-tech.name: Texas Tech Red Raiders (Double T)
texas-tech.notes: Primary athletics mark; added 2026-11-06 with the Texas Tech category. Unmodified.
